description: Wever Checks: submit a market identifier (Hyperliquid perpetual, Kalshi ticker or Polymarket slug) or a supplied market data sample and get a signed evidence report on mark price freshness, index sanity (mark-to-index gap in basis points) and funding recency, recording each value seen, its time basis and its age. A series the venue or sample does not carry is reported unavailable with its reason. Optional thresholds. POST /api/market-data-check. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/checks-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/checks/.

inputSchema.description: Exactly one of market or sample.

id.description: Hyperliquid perpetual coin (for example BTC), Kalshi market ticker or Polymarket market slug.

max_funding_age_seconds.description: Age limit for the latest funding observation. Default 28800.

max_index_deviation_bps.description: Largest mark-to-index gap in basis points. Default 100.

max_mark_age_seconds.description: Mark price age limit at check time. Default 60.

sample.description: Market data as JSON or serialized JSON, up to 256 KB: mark_price, index_price and funding_rate as values or {value, timestamp, source} objects, or flat fields with a shared timestamp.

max_funding_age_seconds.description: Age limit for the latest funding observation. Default 28800.

max_index_deviation_bps.description: Largest mark-to-index gap in basis points. Default 100.

max_mark_age_seconds.description: Mark price age limit at check time. Default 60.

name: wever_market-data-check
title: Market data check
